mostWorthwhile.text: Pressurizing the enclosure was most worthwhile: the leak check and stepping inside made the construction feel tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Laying the blocks was straightforward but the result gave little detail.

surprise.text: The underlay's role in keeping ceramic edges away from the pressure skin made the floor assembly clearer.

arbitrary.text: None felt clearly arbitrary; the later actions followed a logical construction sequence, although most were the only offered gameplay choice.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the growing room is used; its construction was physically understandable, though the mostly forced sequence offered few decisions.
